findings.desc: quality-duplication: runtime-environment-checks.ts:791-800 (resolveCanonicalCoreRoot) duplicates the exact git-worktree-list-porcelain-parsing loop already implemented in resolveCanonicalSelfCoreRoot at runtime-environment-checks.ts:761-770 (identical 9-line block: split into records, find worktree/branch lines, match branch===refs/heads/main, build candidate=join(worktree,packages,main), return realpath if exists). This copies rather than shares the parsing logic the story explicitly set out to mirror. A future fix to the parsing (CRLF handling, detached-HEAD worktree rows, path separators) would need to land in two places and could silently drift apart since nothing enforces they stay in sync. Recommend extracting a shared helper (e.g. findMainBranchWorktreeRoot(anchorDir): string | null) that both functions call, each applying their own already-different fallback semantics on top.
